Built the Do-mode screening leg end to end, behind CONTENT_SAFETY_SCREEN_RPC (strict literal true, default off). With the switch off, the output, provenance and screening_taint are unchanged: the local verdict is returned untouched.

Proto: rpc ScreenContent next to Health, plus ScreenContentRequest (fields 1-7) and ScreenContentResponse (fields 1-8). Verdict only, no content field. Additive; Go and Python bindings still need buf generate.

Gateway (grpc.rs): ScreenContent handler. The caller must pass authorize_request(RpcAccess::Tool) and be a service identity. It reads the org policy with the forwarded capability bearer (absent: env mode capped at tighten, screening on). It calls enforce_screen with a classifier budget of 1 only when the inline switch is on and an inference bearer was forwarded; otherwise the budget is 0 and no classifier call is made. The response carries posture, trust class, semantic outcome, withhold, content hash, rule ids and mode.

Auth answer, read from grpc_auth.rs: the ProxyMcpTool path carries the execution service's own Auth Core token (GatewayTokens, org-scoped, scopes gateway:read and tools:execute) as the authorization header, and the gateway gate is RpcAccess::Tool plus a service-only check. ScreenContent reuses that exact gate, so no gate change was needed. The capability bearer rides as x-capability-authorization and is verified by capability-core. Only an inference_bearer() accessor was added to grpc_auth.rs.

Execution-core: screening_client.rs (new). screen_result asks only for external results whose local scan covered the full payload (Clean or Flagged), never on ZDR, with a 3 s deadline. It fails open to the local verdict on error, timeout, or a content_hash mismatch. The merge is tighten-only. A withhold replaces the output before render. taint is set when the merged result is audit-worthy and the verdict was consulted. The module is attached from provenance.rs with #[path] (see needs_other_files). The browser lifecycle function and the render seam now use it.
